summary: Updated implementation plan for SAMUDRA-DATA incorporating a comprehensive Data Mining & K-Means Clustering Suite. Features interactive K-Means on oceanographic/hazard regimes, fisheries catch profiles, and eDNA k-mer genomic vectors; interactive Elbow method (WCSS vs k), Silhouette score evaluation, PCA 2D scatter projection, centroid radar profiles, and exportable Python scikit-learn scripts for academic submission.
